The '''Coronet Junction''' was the public transport system of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. [[Rocket tram]]s operated on its tracks, which ran through major districts of Coronet City via Tram Stations.

==Description==
===Design===
{{Quote|The Republic's got allies all over Corellia, but without access to the rocket tram system, most of the Republic army is stuck here.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Hartke]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Coronet_Junction_map.png|thumb|left|240px|Map of Coronet Junction]]
Coronet Junction was made up of Tram Stations placed throughout the sprawling skylines of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Coronet Junction Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Rocket Tram System}}</ref>

Between the stations were large, raised tracks upon which ran fast [[rocket tram]]s. The Junction had two levels of tracks, one above the other. Although most of the Junction was exposed to the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]], some portions of the track ran through [[Skyscraper/Legends|buildings]], which contained dedicated tunnels for the trams to pass through.<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" />

A major thoroughfare was located between the tram stations of the [[Imperial war camp]] in [[Labor Valley]], [[Blastfield Shipyards]], [[Axial Park North]], and the [[Incorporation Islands Tram Station]].<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" />

The Junction was able to function even when divided between two opposing factions, with the thoroughfare subdivided for trams to change lines amongst their belonging faction's portion of the transport system.<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" />

Long before the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="TOR dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref><ref name="1.7">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130205|text=Game Update 1.7 Developer Blog: Galactic Reputation}}</ref> the city-wide tram rail network had become too complex for manual control, leading to the handover of the Junction's direction to dedicated [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. As a result of this high level of automation, some [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] wondered if the tram network was truly safe, though the only recourse would be reducing the functionality of the entire system.<ref name="Coronet Junction Codex" />

===Utilization===
{{Quote|The Republic's using the rocket tram's green line to run fresh troops and supplies across Coronet City. The Empire wants that tram derailed. I've got the bombs built, but no way of getting to the tracks and setting them up. The Republic's got squads and snipers patrolling the entire line.|Kapp Zyman|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] used Coronet Junction to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] themselves throughout Coronet City, quickly establishing an Imperial occupation<ref name="Corporate Warfare">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Corporate Warfare|Corellia}}</ref> that took root in many of the city's districts.<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="TOR dates" /> an Imperial hero utilized the rocket trams for transportation in Coronet City. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], the Empire speculated that their plans for conquering Corellia would be at an end if not for the Junction's rocket trams.<ref name="Corporate Warfare" />

==History==
{{Quote|The invasion was magnificent, our occupation flawless. Imperial forces filled Corellia's high-speed rocket trams. We began to cover Coronet City. Then rebellion erupted. Unruly Corellians knocked out the rocket trams. Now our soldiers are stranded. [...] The guilty party is Corellian Engineering Corporation. The oldest ship manufacturer in Republic history. CEC exploited our one weakness. They turned their ion cannons on all outgoing trams, freezing our invasion, trapping us on the doorstep of the Empire's greatest battle.|Darth Charnus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Coronet_Junction_tunnel.png|thumb|right|255px|Coronet Junction ran through buildings]]
Symbolising Corellia's economic and industrial power as well as its commitment to a relatively clean urban environment, the Junction was a low-cost and effective transportation, becoming one of Corellia's most popular services<ref name="Coronet Junction Codex" /> prior to the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] War.<ref name="TOR dates" /><ref name="1.7" /> As such, corporations competed in adding their own resources to the rapid public transit system and securing advertisement space within its trams through viciously-earned contracts.<ref name="Coronet Junction Codex" />

During the reconstituted Sith Empire's [[Battle of Corellia|invasion of Corellia]], Coronet Junction was taken by Imperial forces, who used it to transport themselves throughout Coronet City, spreading their presence. However, such reliance on the rocket tram system led to the anti-Empire [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation's]] exploitation of the Imperials' plans.<ref name="Corporate Warfare" />

Thus, [[Darth Charnus]], whose [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] was the mastermind and leader of the Imperial invasion, recruited a well-known Empire-aligned individual to sabotage the Corellian resistance's counterstrikes. Tasked to bring down Corellian Engineering Corporation,<ref name="Corporate Warfare" /> the strike force sent by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Charnus eventually succeeded in securing Coronet Junction for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and went on to lead Imperial forces on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] with the use of the Junction's rocket trams.<ref name="Engineering Breakdown">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Engineering Breakdown|Corellia}}</ref>

Around this time, the [[Green line|Green Line]] rocket tram track in [[Axial Park]] was used by the [[Galactic Republic]] to move their [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]. Thus, the Empire hired the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Explosive charge/Legends|demolitionist]] [[Kapp Zyman]] to destroy the tram line.<ref name="Derailing the Rocket Tram" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coronet Junction first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" />

The Junction serves as the in-game transport system for the world of Corellia. Players could board rocket trams from stations placed throughout Coronet City, traveling through Coronet Junction to other stations. The price to travel through one station is 375 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and players may only take the rocket tram on the upper track. Additionally, players are limited to only a portion of the Coronet Junction's lines, and players could only travel to stations controlled by their own faction.<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" />

[[File:Coronet_Junction_concept_art.jpg|thumb|left|320px|Concept art of Coronet Junction]]
In ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', all players could use Coronet Junction's rocket tram system regardless of their current progression in-game.<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" /> This contradicts the mission "Corporate Warfare," in which Darth Charnus says to the Imperial player: "You're trapped here as long as the rocket trams are down," referring to the Empire's portion of the Junction.<ref name="Corporate Warfare" />

Although the concept art for Coronet Junction depicts one rocket tram on both the upper and lower tracks, with the two facing opposite directions, no rocket trams run on the lower track in the game itself, and rocket trams on the upper track go in whichever direction their destinations lie.<ref name="Coronet Junction TOR" />
